protocol.architecture: unchanged frozen RSSM posterior + shared linear actor/value
protocol.target_refresh: once per actor update after all critic fits
protocol.extra_critic_targets: same frozen n-step targets as the actor update; inactive masked
protocol.selection: highest development survival per run; earliest update ties; freeze all before any final
protocol.final_role: report all arms and references, no tuning or reselection
protocol.deployment_gate: No automatic deployment. Require extra-fit policy beats scripted, random and matched untrained in mean and majority of paired worlds for every policy seed; reproducible checkpoint reload.

limitations: Three policy seeds share one frozen world-model seed
Small engineering budget; no continual-learning evidence
Final worlds used once after all six selections; world is paired comparison unit, not each agent
Critic fitting changes policy trajectories; matched joint-step budgets, active-agent exposure reported separately
